analysis: The code snippet calls the `charAt` method on the `absolute` string. The `charAt` method, as per its documentation, throws an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` if the index is negative or not less than the length of the string. In the snippet, the `charAt` method is called with `index` set to `absolute.length() - 1`, which is the last valid index of the string. Therefore, the `index` is never negative and is always less than the length of the string, ensuring that the `IndexOutOfBoundsException` cannot be thrown in this context.
